items.title: Pyramid renders as one continuous enlarged shape at desktop width
steps: 1. Open http://localhost:5170 and scroll to the Stack section (#technologies)
2. Observe the 7 stacked layers
items.expected: All 7 layers are full stacked rows with monotonic widths (narrow top, wide base); no side-by-side split row; no stray connector circle floating mid-pyramid
items.evidence: evidence/stack-hover.png — full pyramid, continuous silhouette (run by Playwright agent)
items.notes: White circle in original bug report was the site's CustomCursor at the parked pointer position, not a UI element

items.title: Animated connector draws from active layer to explanation card
steps: 1. Scroll the Stack section into view
2. Hover the 'App Logic' layer
3. Observe the card content and the connector line
items.expected: Card swaps to App Logic; a line draws in from the slab's visible slanted edge (port circle sits ON the edge) to the card's left edge, with flowing dashes and a pulsing end dot
items.evidence: evidence/stack-hover.png (light), evidence/stack-dark.png (dark) — connector visible in both themes
items.notes: Root cause fixed: pathLength and custom strokeDasharray no longer animate on the same path

items.title: Mobile stacking intact, connector hidden
steps: 1. Resize to 390×844
2. Scroll through the Stack section
items.expected: Layers render full-width and readable, explanation card stacks below the pyramid, connector SVG is display:none
items.evidence: evidence/stack-mobile.png; getComputedStyle check returned connectorHiddenOnMobile: true

items.title: (Rev 1) Card matches fragment material; apex cap; scaled pyramid; prominent connector
steps: 1. Scroll to the Stack section in light mode, hover 'Stored Information'
2. Compare the card's background material to the pyramid slabs
3. Observe the text-free triangle capping the pyramid
4. Toggle dark mode and re-check the connector
items.expected: Card shares the slab sheen/border material; apex triangle base aligns with the first slab's top edge; pyramid capped at 44rem with larger small type; connector clearly visible (thick draw line + chunky flowing dashes) in both themes
items.evidence: evidence/stack-rev1.png (dark), evidence/stack-rev1-light.png (light) — run by Playwright agent

items.title: (Rev 2) Scaffold crew animates along left slope; tech tray swaps per fragment
steps: 1. Scroll to the Stack section and watch the left side of the pyramid
2. Hover 'App Screens', then 'Launch and Hosting'
3. Toggle dark mode and re-check the tray icons
items.expected: A worker figure sits on a plank at each slab's left edge (subtle work-loop animation); a small block loops bottom-to-apex along the slope corner line without crossing onto slabs; below the card a 'Preferred tools' tray animates out/in with the fragment's brand-color icons; near-black marks (Vercel, Copilot, Express) render light in dark mode
items.evidence: evidence/stack-rev2b.png (light, App Screens tray), evidence/stack-rev2-dark.png (dark, Launch tray) — run by Playwright agent
items.notes: Hoist path corrected mid-review: linear 0%→27% matches the row corner line exactly

items.title: (Rev 3) Varied pictogram crew; AWS/GCP/Azure in hosting tray; label removed
steps: 1. Scroll to the Stack section and inspect the workers on the left slope
2. Activate 'Launch and Hosting' and inspect the tray below the card
items.expected: Workers are chunky pictogram figures in distinct poses on varied rigs (plank, rope-hung platform, block piers, ladder with climber); hosting tray shows AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel, Docker, GH Actions, Cloudflare with correct brand marks; no 'Preferred tools' label
items.evidence: evidence/stack-rev3-light.png (light, hosting tray), evidence/stack-rev3.png (dark, crew variety) — run by Playwright agent
items.notes: AWS/Azure paths inlined from archived simple-icons v9 (both marks removed from current library on vendor request)

items.title: (Rev 4) Limb-only worker animation; synced hoist interaction; AI tray icons
steps: 1. Watch the crew: bodies should hold still while one limb works
2. Watch a full hoist cycle: base worker shoves, box climbs the slope, apex receiver reaches as it arrives
3. Activate 'AI-Assisted Building' and check the tray
items.expected: No whole-body wobble; loader/box/receiver share one synchronized timeline; AI tray shows Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, Kimi, Copilot with correct marks
items.evidence: evidence/stack-rev4-ai2.png (AI tray + crew), evidence/stack-rev4-ai.png (box mid-hoist on the slope) — run by Playwright agent
items.notes: OpenAI mark inlined from archived simple-icons v9 (removed from current library); Gemini/Kimi from current package

items.title: (Rev 5) Tower crane scene replaces figures; Hero card wrap + Explore removal
steps: 1. Scroll to the Stack section: lattice crane at the left, jib over the apex
2. Watch a full 16s cycle: signaler waves, block lifts, trolley slides, block lowers at the apex, receiver reaches, cable retracts before returning
3. In the Hero deck's projects slide, hover the KuyaDB tile
items.expected: Crane renders in clean drafting linework with zero console errors; mast passes behind slabs; both figures visible outside slab regions; Hero card shows no Explore chip and the description wraps in balanced lines
items.evidence: evidence/stack-rev5.png (jib/apex/receiver), evidence/stack-rev5-base2.png (mast base + signaler); Explore absence verified via DOM text check — run by Playwright agent
items.notes: Fixed during review: framer needs initial{{y2}} to seed animated SVG attrs (console error), and the hook cable now retracts at the apex before the return slide

items.title: (Rev 6) Crane scene removed; section back to clean pyramid + connector + tray
steps: 1. Scroll to the Stack section
2. Confirm no crane, figures, or hoist elements render; hover layers to confirm connector and tray still work
items.expected: Left space is clean; pyramid, apex cap, connector, and tech tray behave as in T2/T7/T8; zero console errors
items.notes: Rev 5 crane item (T9) superseded by removal

items.title: (Rev 7) Composition-fixed crane: tie-ins, jib clear of crown, no figures
steps: 1. Scroll to the Stack section
2. Verify the mast stands at the base corner with tie-in braces ending on the slope edges
3. Watch a cycle: block lifts by the mast, slides, lands on the top layer's left shoulder — never touching the apex cap
4. Toggle dark mode
items.expected: Crane reads structurally attached to the pyramid; no crane element crosses the crown/cap; no figures; clean in both themes with zero console errors
items.evidence: evidence/stack-rev7.png (light), evidence/stack-rev7-dark.png (dark) — run by Playwright agent
items.notes: Supersedes T9 (Rev 5 crane) and T10's removal state per user's 'Fix the crane' choice

items.title: (Rev 8) Crane sans blocks; DB tray additions; centered layout; pointed peak; Codex label
steps: 1. Verify the crane has no counterweight/cab blocks (linework + trolley/block only)
2. Hover 'Stored Information': tray shows PostgreSQL, Knex.js, Redis, MongoDB, MSSQL
3. Verify fragment texts and the section heading are centered, with clear space between heading and the taller pointed apex cap
4. Focus 'AI-Assisted Building': tray shows Codex instead of ChatGPT
items.expected: All four adjustments render; block lands beside the taller peak on the top layer's shoulder; zero console errors
items.evidence: evidence/stack-rev8-peak.png (peak + centered layout + crane), evidence/stack-rev8-centered.png (centered heading + tray); Codex/Kimi presence verified via DOM text check — run by Playwright agent
items.notes: MSSQL mark inlined from archived simple-icons v9 (Microsoft marks removed from current library)

items.title: (Rev 9) Mobile accordion: tap to expand per-fragment panel, one at a time
steps: 1. Scroll to the Stack section and tap 'App Screens'
2. Observe the inline panel (description, why it matters, tech chips)
3. Tap 'Stored Information'
4. Resize to desktop and confirm card/connector/tray unchanged
items.expected: Panel expands under the tapped layer with brand-color chips; tapping another collapses the previous (exactly one open); bottom card/tray hidden on mobile; desktop layout unaffected
items.evidence: evidence/stack-mobile-accordion.png; DOM checks: rightColHidden true on mobile, openPanels 1 after switch (MongoDB chip present), asideVisible true + mobilePanelsVisible 0 on desktop

items.title: Build gates clean
steps: 1. npx tsc --noEmit
2. npm run lint
items.expected: Zero TypeScript errors, zero lint failures
